10 Components of Physical Fitness

Fitness is not defined simply by strength and conditioning. There are eight other components that make up physical fitness. CrossFit describes these as ten general physical skills, and you are only as fit as your competency in each of them.

  1. 1. Cardiovascular / Respiratory Endurance

    How well your body takes in oxygen and gets it where it is needed.

  2. 2. Stamina

    How well your body supplies, stores and uses energy to keep working.

  3. 3. Strength

    How much force your muscles can produce.

  4. 4. Flexibility

    How far you can move each joint through its range of motion.

  5. 5. Power

    How much force you can produce quickly.

  6. 6. Speed

    How fast you can repeat a movement.

  7. 7. Coordination

    How smoothly you can combine different movements into one.

  8. 8. Agility

    How quickly you can switch from one movement to another.

  9. 9. Balance

    How well you can keep your center of gravity over your base of support.

  10. 10. Accuracy

    How precisely you can control a movement’s direction or intensity.

At CrossFit Southie we are constantly working toward all 10 components, which creates a more fit, well balanced individual. Our program is designed to touch on all of these physical skills each week, so do not avoid the workouts and movements you are not good at. Take a long, hard look at this list, work hard on any areas where you are lacking, and your overall fitness will reap the benefits.
